/// AI practice

AI that ships
behind your login.

LLM apps, RAG, agents, voice and vision — grounded in your data, wrapped in the evals and observability production demands.
llm-apps

LLM-native apps

Product surfaces built from the ground up around LLMs — chat, co-pilot, structured generation — with streaming, tool-calling and graceful degradation.

rag

RAG over your data

Retrieval-augmented generation grounded in your internal corpus — vector search, hybrid retrieval, chunking strategies that preserve meaning.

agents

Agentic workflows

Tool-using agents that execute multi-step work reliably — with deterministic evals, retries, budgets and full trace observability.

voice

Voice agents

Real-time voice applications — inbound and outbound — with low-latency turn-taking, barge-in and function-calling.

vision

Vision & multimodal

OCR, document understanding, moderation and product tagging pipelines — with a POV on cost per frame, not just accuracy.

evals

Evals & observability

We treat LLM apps like any other production system — offline evals, online evals, regression suites, tracing and token budgets.

Design & Brand

Data & BI

Analytics pipelines, revenue dashboards and player/fan telemetry that turn activity into decisions.

Dedicated Teams

Senior engineers, designers and PMs on T&M, dedicated or build-your-team engagement models — 50–70% less than onshore.

/// Our approach

How we work.
Listen. Architect. Ship. Scale.

  1. 01

    Listen

    We start with the operator, the artist, the player. Every roadmap begins with a discovery sprint that maps goals, risks and opportunities in plain language.

  2. 02

    Architect

    Clean service boundaries, pragmatic tech choices, and compliance mapped in — especially for Class II / III gaming, payments and regulated AI.

  3. 03

    Ship

    Weekly demos in production-like environments. We favour small, senior teams that ship continuously and measure what they ship.

  4. 04

    Scale

    Post-launch we stay close — observability, release engineering, incident response and iterative improvements that compound.
